slug: 2026-06-15 Namibia encouraged by Angola on datacentre establishment

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa states Namibia already has commercial datacentres, including the Armada datacentre operated by Paratus (no event date given; article published 2026-06-15).

ITWeb Africa states Namibia already has the Virtual Space Data Centre, a commercial datacentre run as a collaboration of Airbus and the Namibia University of Science & Technology (no event date given; article published 2026-06-15).

systems.owner: Airbus and Namibia University of Science & Technology
